name: Secure-Agent-Sandbox
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep git python3-pip && sudo find / -name 'server-main.js' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/out/server-main.js||' | while read root; do sudo mkdir -p "$root/node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin" && sudo cp /usr/bin/rg "$root/node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg"; done
